date.as_written: payodhikhapayodharair mitaśake śriyāsaṃyute tithau sagurupaṃcamena hanubhe ca puṣāhvaye (!)

notes: The catalogue records the place of copying as Mahācīna based on 'mahācīnadeśe', which may belong to the text/chapter colophon ('iti śrīyogasāgare mahācīnadeśe bhṛgusiddhānte bhṛguśukrasaṃvāde...'). Bhṛgu and Śukra are interlocutors in the text and excluded.
